clauses.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
clauses.summary: Financial institutions must identify and verify customers using BVN, NIN, or international passport before establishing business relationships. Risk-based CDD procedures must be implemented including customer identification, verification, and ongoing monitoring.
clauses.penalty_info: Penalties may include fines up to ₦10,000,000 or suspension of license

clauses.title: Transaction Monitoring & PEP Screening
clauses.summary: Real-time transaction monitoring required to detect suspicious activities including unusual transaction patterns and large cash transactions. Customers must be screened against Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) lists with enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers.
clauses.penalty_info: Non-compliance may result in regulatory sanctions and fines

clauses.title: Suspicious Transaction Reporting (STR)
clauses.summary: Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) must be filed with NFIU within 24 hours of forming suspicion. Staff who report suspicious activities in good faith are protected by law.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to file STR within 24 hours may result in significant penalties

clauses.title: Enterprise-wide AML Risk Assessment
clauses.summary: Annual enterprise-wide AML risk assessment covering products, services, customers, and geographic locations. Risk assessment methodology and findings must be documented.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to conduct annual risk assessment may result in enforcement action

clauses.title: Annual AML/CFT Training
clauses.summary: All relevant employees including board members, management, and front-line staff must receive annual AML/CFT training covering recent regulations and emerging risks.
clauses.penalty_info: Inadequate training may be considered a compliance failure

clauses.title: Record Keeping Requirements
clauses.summary: Transaction records, customer identification documents, and account files must be retained for at least 5 years after account closure or transaction completion.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to maintain proper records may result in penalties

clauses.title: Independent AML Compliance Audit
clauses.summary: Annual independent AML compliance audit by internal audit or external qualified party. Audit must assess compliance with AML/CFT obligations and recommend improvements.
clauses.penalty_info: Lack of independent audit may be considered a compliance gap

clauses.title: AML Compliance Officer
clauses.summary: A designated AML/CFT Compliance Officer at senior management level must be appointed to oversee all compliance matters including reporting suspicious transactions to NFIU.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to appoint a compliance officer may result in regulatory action
